result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back from every promotion query you listed. The full offline test suite passes with no failures.

- **`model/Promotion.java`**: added a `description` component after `category`. Null means no description.
- **`resources/schema.sql`**: added a nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column to `promotion`. The database is built fresh from this file, so no migration is needed.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert stores the description. The description is also selected and mapped in the active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category-on-date, unused-in-period and by-code queries, plus the create return value.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new `createPromotion(code, pct, start, end, category, description)` overload. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method delegates to it with no description, so current callers are unchanged.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: added `keepsOptionalDescriptionWithPromotion`, which checks that a created description comes back from a category listing and an active-on-date listing, and that a promotion created without one shows none.

I did not change `DemoScenario`, so the demo promotions have no description. I did not commit.
